title: New Creation
lead: The Bible begins with God making the heavens and the earth (Genesis 1:1) and ends with "a new heaven and a new earth" (Revelation 21:1). Between them, the prophets promise a renewed world (Isaiah 65:17), and Paul calls anyone in Christ "a new creation" (2 Corinthians 5:17). Readers debate whether the new creation replaces this world or renews it.
